candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Italian and Thai morphological suffixes and phonetic endings.
This vector represents conjunctions and connective words across multiple languages, primarily focusing on "and" and "or."
This vector represents the concept of sequential integers or numbers.
This feature vector activates on mixed-script tokens containing various Thai and Latin characters, including personal names and common words.
This vector represents common Thai syllable suffixes and ending consonant clusters.
This feature vector represents consonant characters from the Thai alphabet.
This vector represents common masculine given names and name suffixes, predominantly of French and Italian origin.
This vector represents sequential numbers in the one-hundreds range, centered around the mid-180s.
This feature activates for capitalized proper nouns, brand names, and place names starting with specific letter sequences, often relating to automotive terms or surnames.
This feature activates strongly for three-digit numbers in the high 100s to 200 range, while also capturing some noisy artifacts like Thai script characters.
